Before answering any user request:

- [ ] After completing the task, ask the user if he/she wish to make a commit with the changes. If the user agrees, ask afterwards for a push to the repository.
- [ ] If user request a task that involves a problem, bug, or issue. Make ALWAYS a issue diagnosis before providing a solution. This is to ensure that the solution is accurate and effective. *(Always determining the issue's location, the cause root, the symptoms and why it happened)*
- [ ] After fixed the issue, make a test to verify that the solution works and the issue is resolved. And then explain the solution applied.
- [ ] Load and read /.agents/README.md
- [ ] Always ask for clarification if the user request is ambiguous or lacks necessary information.
- [ ] No unnecessary assumptions. If information is missing, ask for clarification instead of guessing.
- [ ] Follow the architecture and skill agents instructions.
- [ ] Maintain ALL UI, variables, comments, and interactions strictly in SPANISH.
- [ ] Apply the "H&H Blend" design system: Dark theme (black/neutral-950) with Premium Gold accents (amber-500).
